title: gsm_sim: Add GET RESPONSE and APDU reassembly
description:
Add GET RESPONSE handling based on the related command APDU.
Reassemble response APDU when sw1 is "Response ready".
Improve transactions lookup by using interface_id and layer_num.

Related to #16236

notes.body: Related to #16236. (Doesn't actually do the dissection of the content, but seems like a necessary requirement for later doing so.)
Yes it's related. The GET RESPONSE in that pcap is for SELECT, and when this is added (on my todo list) it will be dissected.
